description: This file contains utility functions for managing dashboard filters in a Superset frontend application, including extracting relevant data masks and active filters based on chart configurations and user selections.

classes.name: LayerInfo
classes.description: Interface representing the mapping of chart IDs to layer indices and a set of chart IDs involved in layer selections.

methods.name: extractLayerIndicesFromKeys
methods.description: Parses selected layer keys to extract chart IDs and their corresponding layer indices.
